*   **Limitations:** Texture parameters are immutable after creation; requires manual reload if data changes; padding increases memory usage for non-power-of-two dimensions [S1].

The evidence explicitly states that 'dataDimensions, dataROI, dataType, externalFormat, and internalFormat values of a texture cannot be modified once the texture has been created,' which supports the claim that texture parameters are immutable after creation. It also states that 'The texture data can be modified by using the setDataPtr() method. This call would force TMRenderAction to reload the texture into texture memory,' supporting the need for manual reload if data changes. Finally, it mentions that 'TMRenderAction will internally pad the texture data to create the appropriate power-of-two texture' if dimensions are not powers of two, which supports the claim regarding padding for non-power-of-two dimensions.
